dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Where exactly is the pain in your foot, and when did you first notice it?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: It is mainly on the top of my left foot. The pain started about three days ago.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The foot also looked a little swollen last night, especially compared with the other foot.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you fall, twist your ankle, or injure the foot before the pain started?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. I did not fall or twist it. I went on a very long walk the day before the pain began.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Can you still put your full weight on the foot?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, I can stand and walk, but after a few minutes the pain becomes noticeably worse.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has also been limping since yesterday, especially after walking outside.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Is there one specific point that hurts when you press on it?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes. There is a tender area near the middle of the top of the foot.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will examine the bones, joints, and soft tissues and decide whether an X-ray or another test is necessary.
